lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Hello, is this Dorothy? This is Mark from the fraud department at your bank.

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: We've seen suspicious charges on your account, so we need to act right away.

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: To confirm it's really you, read me the last four digits of your credit card number.

lines.speaker: Dorothy
lines.text: Okay, let me find my card.

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Then I'll text you a one-time code. Read it to me, and we'll move your savings into a safe account.

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Please don't tell anyone at the branch. They might be involved.
